_comment: Site-wide settings. base is the path prefix the site is served under: '/homekeep-site' on the GitHub address, '' once a custom domain is pointed at it. company_line is empty until the company is registered. noindex keeps search engines off the site while it is on the GitHub address. web_app_url is empty until the web version of the app is live; then 'Sign in on the web' appears on the Use Otterly on the web page. app_store_url / play_store_url are empty until the listings exist.
